contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Sestertius of Trajan (98-117), as kindly identified by the finder; mint of Rome, probably issue of 112-114. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust laureate right, viewed from behind shoulder. Obverse inscription: [IMP CAE]S [NER]VAE TRAIANO AVG GERM[--].
